title: Hospital records
goal: Show clinical-record relationships among patients, encounters, clinicians, prescriptions, and laboratory results.

rubric.must: Patient visibly has a one-to-many relationship to Encounter.
Encounter visibly has one-to-many relationships to both Prescription and Lab Result.
Clinician visibly connects to encounters and authorises prescriptions.
Patient, Encounter, Clinician, Prescription, and Lab Result are visible as distinct labelled entities.
Encounter timing, medication, and laboratory test/result fields are visibly readable.
The relationship endpoints visibly communicate optionality and multiplicity.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source, the rubric and the erd exemplar, without seeing the engine's own output.

review.evidence: All five entities and their fields are visible and readable. The relationship lines are traceable, with endpoints showing the specified one-to-many optional cardinalities; no material overlap or cropping is visible.

items.evidence: PATIENT connects to ENCOUNTER with a single marker at Patient and optional-many markers at Encounter.
ENCOUNTER connects separately to PRESCRIPTION and LAB_RESULT, with one at Encounter and optional-many at each record entity.
CLINICIAN connects to ENCOUNTER via “attends” and to PRESCRIPTION via “authorises”; both show one clinician to optional-many records.
PATIENT, ENCOUNTER, CLINICIAN, PRESCRIPTION, and LAB_RESULT appear as distinct labeled entities.
ENCOUNTER shows admitted_at and encounter_type; PRESCRIPTION shows medication; LAB_RESULT shows test_name and result_value. The fields are readable.
Relationship endpoints visibly distinguish exactly one from optional one-or-many using bars, circles, and crow’s-foot markers.
